system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"You know what's really annoying <USER> ? You un-download my library all the f**king time. I have no signal an no music now. & I pay £15 a month. Not to mention long term members NEVER get any discounts or offers."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Hi Abbie, that's not fun! Check out the steps under “Downloads unexpectedly removed” at <URL> Keep us posted"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply is too brief and lacks empathy for customer's frustration."}
